In the upcoming NHL game, scheduled for October 20 at 7:00PM ET:
If the Avalanche win, the market will resolve to "Avalanche".
If the Devils win, the market will resolve to "Devils".
If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed.
If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.
The result will be determined based on the final score including any overtime periods and shootouts. In the event of a shootout, one goal will be added to the winning team's score for the purpose of resolution.

Florence: Yanaki Milev vs Lorenzo Giustino

This market refers to the tennis match between Yanaki Milev and Lorenzo Giustino in the Florence, originally scheduled for October 20, 2026 at 9:30AM ET.

This market will resolve to 'Yanaki Milev' if Yanaki Milev advances against Lorenzo Giustino.

This market will resolve to 'Lorenzo Giustino' if Lorenzo Giustino advances against Yanaki Milev.

If the match is canceled (not played at all), ends in a tie, or a winner has not been determined by November 3, 2026, 11:59 PM ET (14 days after the scheduled start), this market will resolve to 50-50.

If the match begins but is not completed, and one player advances due to the opponent's retirement, default, or disqualification, this market will resolve to the player who advances.

If the match ends in a walkover (player withdraws before the start and the other advances automatically), this market will resolve to 50-50.

The primary resolution source will be official information from the ATP Tour. A consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

In the upcoming NFL football game between Chiefs and Seahawks, scheduled for October 25 at 8:20PM ET:
This market will resolve to "Chiefs" if Chiefs win the game.
This market will resolve to "Seahawks" if Seahawks win the game.
Overtime is included if played.
If the game ends in a tie, this market will resolve 50-50.
If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed.
If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.
